item: OSM: the trends and profile panels walked in Chromium; a 17-column table no longer widens the whole page, and a day does not break at its hyphens
summary: A seeded lane (DEU with a daily window and a history cut, FRA without) was walked in en, ar (RTL) and zh at 375 px and en at 1280 px: the trends tabs, the three profile tabs, the source line and the computed, POST, stored round trip. Two defects, both in the shared table helper: the contact-channels table (17 columns) sat in a scroll box that still counted its width toward the grid track the World map tab lives in, so the section measured 1369 px in a 990 px column and the page scrolled sideways at desktop width (the box now takes zero intrinsic width: width:0; min-width:100%); and a day or month in the first column broke at its hyphens at phone width (now one word, also inside the direction isolates a right-to-left page wraps dates in). Node test pins both. No new keys. Round trip verified: the page shows 'computed', one POST, then the stored line with no reload.
